MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[r:Wire]->(b:Node) WHERE ((a.t = 1 AND b.t = 1) OR (a.t = 2 AND b.t = 2)) AND r.t = 1 
WITH collect(DISTINCT r) AS allEdges 
WITH reduce( acc = {matchedEdges: [], matchedNodes: []}, e IN allEdges | CASE WHEN collections.contains(acc.matchedNodes, startNode(e)) OR collections.contains(acc.matchedNodes, endNode(e)) THEN acc ELSE { matchedEdges: acc.matchedEdges + e, matchedNodes: acc.matchedNodes + [startNode(e), endNode(e)] } END ) AS result 
WITH result.matchedEdges AS matchedEdges 

UNWIND matchedEdges AS e
WITH startNode(e) AS u, endNode(e) AS v, e, matchedEdges
CREATE (merged:Node { id: u.id, qubit: coalesce(u.qubit, -1), row: coalesce(u.row, -1), phase: coalesce(u.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(v.phase, 0.0), t: u.t, graph_id: u.graph_id })
WITH matchedEdges, collect({u: u, v: v, merged: merged, e: e}) AS merges

WITH merges, 
     reduce(lst = [], m IN merges | lst + [{old: id(m.u), new: id(m.merged)}, {old: id(m.v), new: id(m.merged)}]) AS reps,
     reduce(lste = [], m IN merges | lste + [id(m.e)]) AS e_ids

UNWIND merges AS m
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:Wire]-() WHERE id(n) IN [id(m.u), id(m.v)] AND NOT id(r) IN e_ids
WITH DISTINCT r, reps, merges

WITH r, reps, merges, startNode(r) AS sn, endNode(r) AS en
WITH r, reps, merges,
     [rep IN reps WHERE rep.old = id(sn) | rep.new] AS sn_rep,
     [rep IN reps WHERE rep.old = id(en) | rep.new] AS en_rep
WHERE r IS NOT NULL

WITH r, merges,
     CASE WHEN size(sn_rep) > 0 THEN sn_rep[0] ELSE id(startNode(r)) END AS final_sn_id,
     CASE WHEN size(en_rep) > 0 THEN en_rep[0] ELSE id(endNode(r)) END AS final_en_id

MATCH (n1:Node) WHERE id(n1) = final_sn_id
MATCH (n2:Node) WHERE id(n2) = final_en_id
CREATE (n1)-[:Wire {t: r.t, graph_id: r.graph_id}]->(n2)

WITH DISTINCT merges
UNWIND merges AS m
DETACH DELETE m.u, m.v
WITH DISTINCT merges
RETURN size(merges) AS merged

CALL {
// For each pattern
MATCH (a {graph_id: $graph_id})
WHERE a.pattern_id IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT a.pattern_id AS pid, a.graph_id AS graph_id

// Collect nodes in A and B for this pattern
MATCH (a1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 1})
WITH pid, collect(a1) AS A, graph_id
MATCH (b1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 2})
WITH pid, A, collect(b1) AS B, graph_id
WHERE size(A) + size(B) > 2

// Create new supernodes
CREATE (newA:Node {t: 2, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})
CREATE (newB:Node {t: 1, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})

// Reconnect edges to the new nodes
WITH A, B, pid, newA, newB
UNWIND A AS oldA
MATCH (oldA)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newA)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, B, newA, newB, collect(oldA) AS oldANodes

UNWIND B AS oldB
MATCH (oldB)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newB)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, newA, newB, oldANodes, collect(oldB) AS oldBNodes

// Connect the new supernodes
CREATE (newA)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: newA.graph_id}]->(newB)

// Delete the old nodes
FOREACH (n IN oldANodes + oldBNodes | DETACH DELETE n)
RETURN pid, newA, newB
}
CALL {
  MATCH (n)
  REMOVE n.pattern_id
}
RETURN pid, newA, newB;

MATCH path = (start {graph_id: $graph_id})-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE 
  // Even length path
  size(relationships(path)) % 2 = 0
  // All edges are unmarked Hadamard edges
  AND ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.t = 2 AND edge.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // All intermediate nodes are unmarked identity Z-spiders
  AND ALL(node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] 
          WHERE node.t = 1 
          AND node.phase % 2 = 0 
          AND degree(node) = 2 
          AND node.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // Only process unmarked start/end nodes
  AND start.pattern_id IS NULL 
  AND end.pattern_id IS NULL

// Order by path length (longest first) and node IDs for consistency
WITH path, nodes(path) as path_nodes, relationships(path) as path_edges
ORDER BY length(path) DESC, id(nodes(path)[0]), id(nodes(path)[-1])
LIMIT 1

// Mark this pattern with unique ID
WITH path_nodes, path_edges, randomUUID() as pattern_id

// Mark all edges in the path
UNWIND path_edges AS edge
SET edge.pattern_id = pattern_id

// Mark all intermediate nodes in the path
WITH path_nodes[1..-1] as intermediate_nodes, pattern_id, path_edges
UNWIND intermediate_nodes AS node
SET node.pattern_id = pattern_id

RETURN DISTINCT pattern_id, length(path_edges) as path_length

// Find all marked patterns
MATCH (s {graph_id: $graph_id})
WHERE s.pattern_id IS NOT NULL

// Reconstruct the full path for each pattern
WITH DISTINCT s.pattern_id AS pattern_id
MATCH path = (start)-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.pattern_id = pattern_id)
AND start.pattern_id IS NULL AND end.pattern_id IS NULL AND id(start) < id(end)

WITH start, end, pattern_id,
      [node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE node.pattern_id = pattern_id] as nodes_to_delete

// Create direct connection
WITH DISTINCT start, end, nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
CREATE (start)-[newWire:Wire {t: 1}]->(end)

// Delete the nodes with the corresponding Hadamard edges
WITH nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
UNWIND nodes_to_delete AS node
DETACH DELETE node

// Return something to ensure changes were made
WITH pattern_id
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT pattern_id) as patterns_processed

MATCH (b:Node {graph_id: $graph_id}) WHERE b.phase % 2 = 0 AND b.t = 1 AND degree(b) = 2 MATCH (v1 {graph_id: $graph_id})-[e1:Wire]-(b)-[e2:Wire]-(v2) WHERE id(v1) < id(v2) AND NOT (v1.t = 0 AND v2.t = 0) AND NOT (v1.t = 1 AND v1.phase % 2 = 0 AND degree(v1) = 2 AND id(v1) < id(b)) AND NOT (v2.t = 1 AND v2.phase % 2 = 0 AND degree(v2) = 2 AND id(v2) < id(b)) WITH b, v1, v2, e1, e2, CASE WHEN (e1.t + e2.t) % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS new_type CREATE (v1)-[:Wire {t: new_type, graph_id: coalesce(b.graph_id, v1.graph_id)}]->(v2) WITH DISTINCT b WITH collect(b) AS deleted FOREACH(node IN deleted | DETACH DELETE node) RETURN CASE WHEN size(deleted) > 0 THEN true ELSE null END AS removed_identities;

code.value: MATCH (a {t: 1, graph_id: $graph_id})-[pivot_edge:Wire {t: 2}]-(b {t: 1}) WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL AND a.phase = round(a.phase) AND b.phase = round(b.phase) AND size([(a)-[ea:Wire]-() WHERE ea.t <> 2 | 1]) = 0 AND size([(b)-[eb:Wire]-() WHERE eb.t <> 2 | 1]) = 0 AND size([(a)-[:Wire]-(na) WHERE coalesce(na.t, -1) <> 1 | 1]) = 0 AND size([(b)-[:Wire]-(nb) WHERE coalesce(nb.t, -1) <> 1 | 1]) = 0 WITH a, b, pivot_edge LIMIT 1 OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor_a {t: 1}) WHERE neighbor_a <> b AND size([(neighbor_a)-[:Wire]-(b) | 1]) = 0 WITH a, b, pivot_edge, COLLECT(DISTINCT neighbor_a) as neighbors_a OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor_b {t: 1}) WHERE neighbor_b <> a AND size([(neighbor_b)-[:Wire]-(a) | 1]) = 0 AND NOT neighbor_b IN neighbors_a WITH a, b, pivot_edge, neighbors_a, COLLECT(DISTINCT neighbor_b) as neighbors_b OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(shared {t: 1})-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(b) WITH a, b, pivot_edge, neighbors_a, neighbors_b, COLLECT(DISTINCT shared) as shared_neighbors CALL { WITH neighbors_a, neighbors_b UNWIND neighbors_a AS node_a UNWIND neighbors_b AS node_b OPTIONAL MATCH (node_a)-[existing:Wire]-(node_b) WITH node_a, node_b, collect(existing) AS edges FOREACH (e IN edges | DELETE e) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(edges) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (node_a)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: coalesce(node_a.graph_id, node_b.graph_id)}]->(node_b) ) } CALL { WITH neighbors_a, shared_neighbors UNWIND neighbors_a AS node_a UNWIND shared_neighbors AS shared_node OPTIONAL MATCH (node_a)-[existing:Wire]-(shared_node) WITH node_a, shared_node, collect(existing) AS edges FOREACH (e IN edges | DELETE e) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(edges) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (node_a)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: coalesce(node_a.graph_id, shared_node.graph_id)}]->(shared_node) ) } CALL { WITH neighbors_b, shared_neighbors UNWIND neighbors_b AS node_b UNWIND shared_neighbors AS shared_node OPTIONAL MATCH (node_b)-[existing:Wire]-(shared_node) WITH node_b, shared_node, collect(existing) AS edges FOREACH (e IN edges | DELETE e) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(edges) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (node_b)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: coalesce(node_b.graph_id, shared_node.graph_id)}]->(shared_node) ) } FOREACH (n IN neighbors_a | SET n.phase = ((coalesce(n.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(b.phase, 0.0)) % 2.0 + 2.0) % 2.0 ) FOREACH (n IN neighbors_b | SET n.phase = ((coalesce(n.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(a.phase, 0.0)) % 2.0 + 2.0) % 2.0 ) FOREACH (shared_neighbor IN shared_neighbors | SET shared_neighbor.phase = ((coalesce(shared_neighbor.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(a.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(b.phase, 0.0) + 1.0) % 2.0 + 2.0) % 2.0 ) WITH a, b DETACH DELETE a, b RETURN count(a) AS pivot_operations_performed;

items.title: Pivot rule - single interior Pauli spider

code.value: MATCH (a {t: 1, graph_id: $graph_id})-[:Wire {t : 2}]-(b {t: 1}) WHERE a.phase = round(a.phase) AND b.phase = round(b.phase) MATCH (b)-[:Wire]-(b_neighbor) WITH a, b, COUNT(CASE WHEN coalesce(b_neighbor.t, -1) = 0 THEN 1 END) as boundary_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN coalesce(b_neighbor.t, -1) <> 0 THEN 1 END) as non_boundary_count, COLLECT(CASE WHEN coalesce(b_neighbor.t, -1) = 0 THEN b_neighbor END)[0] as boundary_vertex WHERE boundary_count = 1 AND non_boundary_count = 1 MATCH (a)-[all_a_edges:Wire]-() WITH a, b, boundary_vertex, COUNT(CASE WHEN coalesce(all_a_edges.t, 1) <> 2 THEN 1 END) as non_t2_edges WHERE non_t2_edges = 0 WITH a, b, boundary_vertex LIMIT 1 MATCH (b)-[boundary_edge:Wire]-(boundary_vertex) SET a.phase = ((coalesce(a.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(b.phase, 0.0)) % 2.0 + 2.0) % 2.0 WITH a, b, boundary_vertex, boundary_edge, CASE boundary_edge.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END as new_edge_type CREATE (a)-[new_connection:Wire {t: new_edge_type, graph_id: coalesce(a.graph_id, 0)}]->(boundary_vertex) DETACH DELETE b RETURN COUNT(a) as interior_pauli_removed;

MATCH (n {graph_id: $graph_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)--(m)
WITH n, count(m) AS degree
WITH degree, count(*) AS frequency
RETURN degree, frequency
ORDER BY degree;

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[r:Wire]-(v) WHERE v.t IN [1, 2] WITH v, collect(r) AS self_loops WHERE size(self_loops) > 0 WITH v, self_loops, size([r IN self_loops WHERE r.t = 2]) AS hadamard_count FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN hadamard_count % 2 = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET v.phase = coalesce(v.phase, 0) + 1) WITH v, self_loops UNWIND self_loops AS loop_edge DELETE loop_edge RETURN count(DISTINCT v) AS vertices_processed
MATCH (n {graph_id: $graph_id})-[r]-(m) WHERE degree(n) = 1 AND degree(m) = 1 DETACH DELETE n, m WITH count(n) AS deleted_pairs MATCH (v {graph_id: $graph_id}) WHERE degree(v) = 0 DELETE v;

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1}), (w:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1}) WHERE id(v) < id(w) AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(w) AND abs((v.phase * 2) - round(v.phase * 2)) > 1e-5 AND abs((w.phase * 2) - round(w.phase * 2)) > 1e-5 AND size((v)-[:Wire]-()) = size((w)-[:Wire]-()) AND size([(v)-[:Wire]-(n) WHERE NOT (n)-[:Wire]-(w) | 1]) = 0 WITH v, w WITH v, w, v.phase + w.phase AS s, v.phase - w.phase AS d WITH v, w, (abs(s - round(s)) < 1e-5 AND toInteger(round(s)) % 2 <> 0) AS sum_odd, (abs(d - round(d)) < 1e-5 AND toInteger(round(d)) % 2 <> 0) AS diff_odd WHERE sum_odd OR diff_odd OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN sum_odd THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET n.phase = coalesce(n.phase, 0.0) + 1.0) DETACH DELETE v, w RETURN count(*) as c

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1}), (w:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1}) WHERE id(v) < id(w) AND (v)-[:Wire]-(w) AND abs((v.phase * 2) - round(v.phase * 2)) > 1e-5 AND abs((w.phase * 2) - round(w.phase * 2)) > 1e-5 AND size((v)-[:Wire]-()) = size((w)-[:Wire]-()) AND size([(v)-[:Wire]-(n) WHERE n <> w AND NOT (n)-[:Wire]-(w) | 1]) = 0 WITH v, w WITH v, w, v.phase + w.phase AS s, v.phase - w.phase AS d WITH v, w, (abs(s - round(s)) < 1e-5 AND toInteger(round(s)) % 2 = 0) AS sum_even, (abs(d - round(d)) < 1e-5 AND toInteger(round(d)) % 2 <> 0) AS diff_odd WHERE sum_even OR diff_odd OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n) WHERE n <> w FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN sum_even THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET n.phase = coalesce(n.phase, 0.0) + 1.0) DETACH DELETE v, w RETURN count(*) as c
